title: Minigame: E1.8 Gunflashes and E1.921 Starshells

source.basis: Manufactured under R0.3 as the minigame of the E1.8 claim (the Rules-first plan, section 7): a night firefight in which Gunflashes are marked and the first Starshell is tried, its facts entered by hand.
source.legacy: None: a manufactured minigame (R0.3), adapting no legacy card
adaptation: A minimal card (ruling R22.3): a German squad with a MMG, a German leader, a German tank with an Armor Leader, and a Russian squad, set up by hand; the night is a fact of each check.

introduction: A German squad fires at night: where does its Gunflash stay, and who may then try the first Starshell?

victoryConditions.text: A minigame has no victory: it proves its rules on the Rule Workbench and in play.
